message: Build a single local index.html cafe menu for the fictional Juniper cafe, with twelve sample dishes grouped by breakfast, lunch and drinks, prices and vegetarian labels. Add a vegetarian-only toggle and a useful empty state per section. Use inline CSS/vanilla JS, accessible keyboard controls and a stylish responsive layout. No ordering, external assets or build.

profile.sections: use the sections in the brief
profile.platform: local Windows and Python 3 stdlib for CLI; modern desktop/mobile browser for web
